problem_statement:
Jetpack monthly plans show "errors" about expiring in a month
We offer Jetpack plans billed monthly, but in the Manage Purchases section of Calypso, they show up as if there's a problem, causing anxiety and concern for folks, when there's nothing actually wrong.

![screen shot 2018-02-23 at 7 57 59 am](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/108942/36600385-57b4073a-186f-11e8-806a-f05e603aae81.png)

We should reduce the severity of that notice, or possibly even just remove it entirely.

Note: this might be because I am using credits on this purchase, so it cannot (currently) auto-renew. If that's the case, then we should make the message be more about having a billable payment method on file or something that makes a bit more contextual sense.
